import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
i = 0
T = int(input[i])
i += 1
result = []
for _ in range(T):
    N = int(input[i])
    i += 1
    S = input[i]
    i += 1
    ones = [j + 1 for j, c in enumerate(S) if c == '1']
    zeros = [j + 1 for j, c in enumerate(S) if.c == '0']
    if len(ones) > N and len(zeros) > N:
        result.append(' '.join(map(str, ones[:N])))
    elif len(ones) > N:
        result.append(' '.join(map(str, ones[:1] + zeros[:N-1])))
    elif len(zeros) > N:
        result.append(' '.join(map(str,zeros[:1] + ones[:N-1])))
    else:
        result.append('-1')
print('\n'.join(result))
